cards.text:
审判庭特勤
战略计谋
定罪
没有什么能够逃离审判庭的铁拳。那些遭受
谴责并定为有罪的目标将在残酷的特勤们面
前颤抖。
选择一名敌方特工并掷一枚 D3。在当前转折点
的交战阶段中，除非这名特工是最后被激活的敌
方特工，或者您的对手激活了相当于掷骰结果数
量的其他敌方特工（以先满足的条件为准)，否
则这名特工不能被激活或者执行行动。如果您在
战斗中已经使用过了本计谋，那么您在之后每次
使用本计谋时需比之前多消耗 1CP（第一次使用
时为 1CP，第二次使用时为 2CP，以此类推)。
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
STRATEGY PLOY
DENOUNCE
None escape the long arm of the Inquisition. Those
denounced and proclaimed guilty quail before its
vengeful Agents.
Select one enemy operative and roll one D3. In
the Firefight phase of this turning point, that
enemy operative cannot be activated or perform
actions until it's the last enemy operative to
be activated, or your opponent has activated a
number of enemy operatives equal to the result
of the D3 (whichever comes first). This ploy costs
you 1 additional CP for each previous time you’ve
used it during the battle (e.g. 1CP the first time
you would use it, 2CP the second time, etc.).

cards.text:
审判庭特勤
战略计谋
严密检查
没有什么能够躲过审判庭的全视之眼。
在您为一名己方审判庭特勤特工选择有效目标
时，位于其 4" 内的敌方特工不能拥有掩护（而不
是 2")。虽然这样能够让敌方特工成为目标（假
设它们可见)，但不会移除这些敌方特工的掩护
豁免（若有)，除非己方审判庭特勤特工位于目
标的 2" 内。
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
STRATEGY PLOY
INTENSE SCRUTINY
There is no hiding from the all-seeing eyes of
the Inquisition.
Whenever you’re selecting a valid target for a
friendly INQUISITORIAL AGENT operative,
enemy operatives within 4" of it cannot be in
cover (instead of 2"). While this can allow such
operatives to be targeted (assuming they’re
visible), it doesn’t remove their cover save (if
any), unless the friendly INQUISITORIAL AGENT
operative is within 2" as normal.

cards.text:
审判庭特勤
战略计谋
猎物
那些被定为罪人的存在是无处可逃的。一旦被
标记处决，审判庭的目标就必将遭到毁灭。
选择一名敌方特工来作为本次转折点中的猎物。
每当一名己方审判庭特勤特工对己方猎物进行
射击、近战或反击时，它的武器拥有“无休”武
器规则。在己方的猎物被残废后，您可以选择新
的敌方特工来作为猎物（并且在转折点期间可以
重复这个过程)。
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
STRATEGY PLOY
QUARRY
For those judged guilty, there is no escape. Once marked
for execution, the Inquisition’s quarry is doomed.
Select one enemy operative to be your quarry
for the turning point. Whenever a friendly
INQUISITORIAL AGENT operative is shooting
against, fighting against or retaliating against your
quarry, that friendly operative’s weapons have
the Ceaseless weapon rule. Whenever your quarry
is incapacitated, you can select a new enemy
operative to be your quarry (and can continue to
do so during this turning point).

cards.text:
审判庭特勤
战略计谋
绝对审判
审判庭的特工们在几乎无尽的权威之下变得英
勇无畏，他们在叛徒和异形面前绝不会屈服。
每当一名特工对位于目标标识 3" 内的己方审判
庭特勤特工进行射击时，您可以重掷一枚自己
的防御骰。如果那名己方特工正在争夺那个标
识，那么您可以重掷任意指定结果的防御骰（例
如结果为 2 的防御骰)。
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
STRATEGY PLOY
IRREFUTABLE JURISDICTION
The Agents of the Inquisition are emboldened by their
near-limitless authority, and will bow before neither
traitor nor xenos.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
INQUISITORIAL AGENT operative that’s within
3" of an objective marker, you can re-roll one
of your defence dice. If that friendly operative
contests that marker, you can re-roll any of your
defence dice results of one result instead (e.g.
results of 2).

cards.text:
审判庭特勤
交战计谋
绝对权威
那些知道审判庭存在的人畏惧着他们的无尽影
响力。那些不幸触怒审判庭特勤的人通常都会
陷入恐惧。
在战斗期间，在一名对手使用战略或交战计谋
时(指挥重掷或花费 0CP 的计谋除外）使用本交
战计谋。对手不能使用那次计谋，返还消耗的
CP，并且对手不能在本次转折点中再次使用那个
计谋。在每场战斗中，本计谋不能被多次用于阻
止同一个计谋的使用。
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ABSOLUTE AUTHORITY
All who know of the Inquisition fear its limitless reach.
Those unfortunate enough to draw the ire of its Agents
are often stricken by fear.
Use this firefight ploy during the battle, when
an opponent uses a strategy or firefight ploy
(excluding Command Re-roll or one that costs
0CP). Their ploy isn’t used, the CP spent on it is
refunded and they cannot use that ploy again
during this turning point. This ploy cannot be
used to stop the same ploy more than once
per battle.

cards.text:
审判庭特勤
交战计谋
不懈追击
审判庭的特勤们以坚持不懈与毫不停息的决心
追击着他们的敌人。
在一名就绪的己方审判庭特勤特工 2" 内的一
名敌方特工执行需要移动的行动时使用本交战计
谋。在那名特工完成移动后，那名己方审判庭特
勤特工可以执行一次无消耗的转移行动，但是
必须在结束移动时位于那名敌方特工的 2" 内，
或者执行一次冲锋行动，但是在结束移动时必须
位于那名敌方特工的控制范围内。如果无法满足
上述的任何一个条件，那么那名己方特工不能执
行上述的行动，并且本计谋不能被使用，返还被
消耗的 CP。
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
RELENTLESS IN PURSUIT
The Inquisition pursues its foes with dogged and
relentless determination.
Use this firefight ploy when an enemy operative
within 2" of a ready friendly INQUISITORIAL
AGENT operative performs an action in
which it moves. After it moves, that friendly
INQUISITORIAL AGENT operative can either
perform a free Reposition action, but must end
that move within 2" of that enemy operative, or
a free Charge action, but must end that move
within control range of that enemy operative. If
neither is possible, that friendly operative cannot
perform those actions, this ploy isn’t used and the
CP spent on it is refunded.

cards.text:
审判庭特勤
交战计谋
帝皇的意志
审判庭的特勤战士们执行着帝皇的意志。这样
的权威使他们在执行任务时变得更加勇猛。
在一名己方审判庭特勤特工被激活时使用本交
战计谋。直到那名特工的激活结束前，您可以忽
略任何对其属性的修正（包括武器属性)。
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
THE EMPEROR'S WILL
The Agents of the Inquisition enforce the Emperor’s will.
This authority emboldens them in their duties.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
INQUISITORIAL AGENT operative is activated.
Until the end of that operative’s activation, you
can ignore any changes to its stats (including its
weapons’ stats).

cards.text:
审判庭特勤
交战计谋
可怕存在
那些拥有审判庭徽记和权力的人深受他人的畏
惧，就算是最为强大的敌人也会变得谨慎。
在一名位于己方审判庭特勤特工 3" 内，或者
位于己方奥术师特工 6" 内且可见的敌方特工执
行拾取标识行动或一次任务行动时（操作舱门除
外）使用本交战计谋。您的对手在执行那次行动
时必须消耗额外 1AP（如果对手不能这么做或者
选择不这么做，那么返还被消耗的 AP)。
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
INTIMIDATING PRESENCE
Those that bear the sigils and authority of the Inquisition
are rightly feared, even by the mightiest of foes.
Use this firefight ploy when an enemy
operative visible to and within 3" of a friendly
INQUISITORIAL AGENT operative, or visible to
and within 6" of a friendly MYSTIC operative,
performs the Pick Up Marker or a mission action
(excluding Operate Hatch). Your opponent must
spend 1 additional AP for that enemy operative to
perform that action (if they cannot or choose not
to, the AP spent on it is refunded).

cards.text:
审判庭特勤
阵营装备
审判圣徽
审判官的徽记拥有着几乎无穷的权威，一切
都将在这枚圣徽面前颤抖。
每场战斗限一次，当一名己方审判庭特勤特工
被激活时，如果您在转折点中使用了“猎物”战
略计谋，那么您可以使用本规则。若使用，那么
直到转折点结束前，您可以将一名新的敌方特工
选作为猎物。
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
INQUISITORIAL ROSETTE
A symbol of an Inquisitor’s near-boundless authority,
the rosette is feared by all.
Once per battle, when a friendly INQUISITORIAL
AGENT operative is activated, if you’ve used the
Quarry strategy ploy during this turning point, you
can use this rule. If you do, you can select a new
enemy operative to be your quarry until the end of
the turning point.

cards.text:
审判庭特勤
阵营装备
格斗匕首
在被迫进行近战肉搏时，一把简单的匕首将
决定特工的生死。
己方审判庭特勤特工装备有以下近战武器。在
一名己方寂静修女特工使用本武器时，其攻击属
性提升 1 点。
名称攻击命中伤害
格斗匕首 3 4+ 3/4
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
COMBAT DAGGERS
In the press of melee combat, a simple dagger can be
the difference between life and death.
Friendly INQUISITORIAL AGENT operatives have
the following melee weapon. Whenever a friendly
SISTER OF SILENCE operative is using it, add 1 to
its Atk stat.
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Combat dagger 3 4+ 3/4

cards.text:
审判庭特勤
阵营装备
装甲紧身衣
这种贴身的连体服轻便但坚固，能够为穿着
者提供一层额外的保护。
当一名特工对豁免属性为 5+ 的己方审判庭特勤
特工（典籍之颅除外）进行射击时，您可以将
一枚结果为 4 的防御骰作为普通成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
ARMOURED BODYSUITS
Lightweight yet tough, these form-fitting bodysuits
provide an extra layer of protection to the wearer.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
INQUISITORIAL AGENT operative (excluding
TOME-SKULL) that has a 5+ Save stat, you can
retain one of your defence dice results of 4 as a
normal success.

cards.text:
审判庭特勤
阵营装备
伺服颅骨
伺服颅骨是漂浮在空中的小型奴工，他们可
以通过改造和设定来协助特工执行各种类型
的任务。
每场战斗限一次，一名己方审判庭特勤特工在
执行一次任务行动时可以少消耗 1AP。
cards.text_en:
INQUISITORIAL AGENT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
SERVO-SKULL
Servo-skulls are diminutive floating servitors that can be
crafted and programmed to assist their operators with a
wide range of tasks.
Once per battle, one friendly INQUISITORIAL
AGENT operative can perform a mission action
for 1 less AP.
